description: Figure 6(a) illustrates the impact of the hyperparameter N on the F1 score, with the x-axis labeled "N" ranging from 0 to 20 in linear scale and the y-axis labeled "F1 Score (%)" ranging from 70 to 100. Five distinct lines represent different methods: SMD (orange line with square markers), PSM (blue line with circle markers), SWaT (green line with triangle markers), SMAP (purple line with diamond markers), and MSI (yellow line with star markers). The SMD line starts at approximately 85% at N=0, rises to a peak of about 95% at N=5, then declines to around 85% at N=20. The PSM line begins near 95%, remains relatively stable, and slightly decreases to about 92% at N=20. The SWaT line starts at approximately 80%, increases to a peak of about 90% at N=10, then declines to around 85% at N=20. The SMAP line begins at approximately 70%, rises to a peak of about 90% at N=10, then declines to around 75% at N=20. The MSI line starts at approximately 80%, increases to a peak of about 88% at N=10, then declines to around 80% at N=20. All lines are solid, and the plot includes a legend in the top left corner identifying each method by its color and marker.
